paragraphs: This is what R' Chiyya called Rav, as explained in his entry.[^1]

notes.text: The heading Bar Pachti supplies what Chiyya called Rav; the older note’s claim that this is unspecified is qualified by that context. Chiyya’s abbreviated title remains R', and Rav is explicit. His entry remains an unbound cross-reference, without an independently established target identity or link.
